Plaintiff: Asha Rao also known as A. Rao
Defendant: Dev Mehta
Claim: breach of the supply agreement
Defence: goods were non-conforming
Counterclaim: loss caused by delayed delivery
Issue: whether payment was due
Sub-issue: whether inspection was waived
Admitted Fact: agreement was signed
Disputed Fact: payment was made
Disputed Fact: payment was not made
Evidence: bank statement
Exhibit: Supply Agreement A
Witness: Priya Sen
Statement: Priya observed delivery
Application: interim injunction request
Hearing: interim application heard
Order: parties directed to preserve goods
Procedural history: plaint filed and summons issued
Relief: damages and specific performance
Section 10 of the Indian Contract Act
Rule 9
2020 SCC 15
On 3 March 2025 the plaint was filed.
